limitations: Only 12 maintenance facts and six selected complaint records checked; not comprehensive or representative coverage.
Source-verified means the statement exists in the cited source, not that a complaint allegation is established.
No typical onset, failure rate, lifespan, reliability score or cost estimate is supported.
Complaint mileage units are not explicit in the selected clauses; confirm before miles-labeled publication.
Commercial OEM-derived publication remains unresolved. Government dataset rights do not clear manufacturer materials or consumer prose.
No manufacturer PDFs, images, screenshots, complaint narratives, VINs or personal details are retained in this batch.
Ford maintenance is not verified: extracted PDF text did not reach the chapter and direct retrieval returned HTML.
